_comment: Rules are tried top-to-bottom; the first fully-matching rule wins. Edit freely to match local recycling/compost program rules -- no code changes needed. 'match' keys are ANDed together; list values mean 'any of'; object_keywords checks for a substring match against the identified object name.

rules.name: film_and_wrappers_landfill
rules.reason: Flexible plastic film, bags, and wrappers are not accepted by most curbside recycling programs.

rules.name: contaminated_landfill
rules.reason: Food or liquid residue contaminates the material, which disqualifies it from recycling.

rules.name: plastic_bottle_recyclable
rules.reason: PET/HDPE bottles, jugs, and containers are widely accepted curbside recyclables.

rules.name: plastic_unknown_subtype
rules.reason: Plastic resin type could not be identified; recyclability depends on the resin code.

rules.name: metal_recyclable
rules.reason: Aluminum and steel cans/containers are widely accepted curbside recyclables.

rules.name: glass_recyclable
rules.reason: Glass bottles and jars are widely accepted curbside recyclables.

rules.name: cardboard_recyclable
rules.reason: Clean cardboard is a widely accepted curbside recyclable.

rules.name: paper_recyclable
rules.reason: Clean paper is a widely accepted curbside recyclable.

rules.name: material_unknown
rules.reason: Material could not be visually identified.
